scope: Independent 16-channel proxy dictionary. Labels describe modeled interventions, not validated subjective states.

sugar.interpretation: Eon v783 sugar GRNs, published IDs

bitter.interpretation: FlyWire v783 bitter annotation; differs from paper v630 subset

water.interpretation: Shiu paper water GRNs; every ID verified present in v783

vinegar.interpretation: Partial vinegar proxy DM1+VA2; not a complete measured odor response

yeast.interpretation: Synthetic yeast-associated odor channel DM2; not specific to yeast

warm.interpretation: Annotated heating cells; tonic activation proxy, no calibrated Celsius

cold.interpretation: Annotated cold cells; tonic activation proxy

bright.interpretation: 128 evenly sampled R1-6 cells; engineering light proxy, LIF approximation

sound.interpretation: Annotated auditory cells; Poisson activation, no acoustic waveform

wind.interpretation: Annotated wind/gravity cells; simplified engineering proxy

overlap_policy: Sum requested Poisson rates on shared cells. This is an explicit engineering mixture rule.
auditory_command_note: Left/right sound channels are an engineered code, not English comprehension. Stop is silence.
